rule: This catalog contains locator hints only. Module names and request paths help acquire the exact target/BSP source; they do not prove API existence, signatures, execution context, side effects or version compatibility.
coverage_note: Candidate module names are discovery vocabulary observed in an authorized BSP reference snapshot. They are not a claim that every target version contains every module, and they are not a substitute for checking the target configuration/BSP version.

version_identity_contract.rule: A module/API presence alone never proves an exact BSP version. Ambiguous evidence remains RANGE_ONLY or UNKNOWN. Identity is baseline-bound and invalidated on participant/artifact/source-root/baseline change.

version_evidence.authority: Exact current Source value only; this hint is routing metadata and never proves the current version.
